segments.name: Biopharmaceutical
segments.description: Clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company developing azenosertib, a kinase inhibitor, for patients with ovarian cancer and other tumor types.
segments.evidence: The Company manages its operations as a single segment for the purposes of assessing performance and making operating decisions.

revenueModel.text: Partners such as Immunome pay for transferred intellectual property and milestone payments; the company currently sells no approved product.
revenueModel.evidence: Immunome has contracted to obtain goods and services that are an output of ordinary activities and is a customer

changes.text: In 2025 the company said it no longer plans further development of azenosertib in uterine serous carcinoma.
changes.evidence: We do not plan further development of azenosertib in USC.

changes.text: In 2024 the company transferred ownership of functional intellectual property to Immunome under asset purchase agreements.
changes.evidence: the Immunome Asset Purchase Agreements represent the transfer of ownership of functional intellectual property
